name: smwmusic-arachno-a-sad-touch
title: Arachno - A Sad Touch
description:
A song that's fairly energetic despite its name, probably best known as the title screen music from Lyle in Cube Sector. Likely fits title screens or other such areas.

Includes two versions for the lead, one using @6, and one using @2, the latter being inspired by neodym65's Superfamicompo 4 port of the same song.
